title: GOV-3 Signed-Release Attack Battery (The Cost Ladder) — In-Band Compromise Closed by One Keyed Signature; the Regress Floor Priced and Shipped as Found
description:
Signed-release attack battery, completing the governance cost ladder. Layer attribution: the keyed signature closed full in-band compromise AND forged signatures; the fingerprint pin caught key replacement; the git-anchored registry caught mutation of released artifacts. Zero operator chat text in any artifact (operator-privacy doctrine): authorization recorded as GO + timestamp only. Operator authorization: Leon GO (chat authorization, 12:06 CT, Oct 13, 2026).

Scope honesty: single-run preregistered falsifier battery on synthetic data against a prototype governed self-healing system; no production claim is made or implied. Operator authorization recorded as GO + timestamp per the operator-privacy doctrine.
